(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer located on opposite sides of a medial section; and an additional adhesive layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with respect to each other.

(Currently Amended) Claim 282: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a composite material.

(Currently Amended) Claim 283: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal honeycomb structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 284: The tool of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 285: The tool of claim 281, further comprising a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments attached to the first and second layers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 286: The tool of claim 281, wherein the first adhesive layer is cured to the first layer and the second adhesive layer is cured to the second layer.

(Currently Amended) Claim 287: The tool of claim 281, wherein the additional adhesive layer is interposed between the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer and configured to be cured.

(Currently Amended) Claim 288: The tool of claim 281, further comprising a circular blade core in which the first and second adhesive layers are secured. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 285, further comprising an inner ring coupled on an inner perimeter to the medial section.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes a central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

(Currently Amended) Claim 293: The tool of claim 285, further comprising a weld ring that is continuous.

(Currently Amended) Claim 294: The tool of claim 284, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring.
